messages:
Zoe: FYI team — OnPrem BYOK + Consent Revocation v1.0 is going GA tonight. This release adds: bring-your-own-key envelopes for audit bundles, a consent-revocation API (so customers can rescind telemetry consent), and an optional outbound webhook for signed revocation receipts. Rollout window and checklist below.
release-bot: Artifact: onprem-byok-consent@v1.0 published to s3://internal-releases/onprem/byok-consent/v1.0. Window: 2026-03-25 00:00 UTC -> 2026-03-25 04:00 UTC. Canary 5% first 20m.
Mateo: Quick q — default telemetry state? Any change there?
Zoe: No change to default behavior: telemetry remains disabled by default for new on-prem/VPC tenants. BYOK is opt-in and only used for audit bundles when customers request local signing.
security: Security note — BYOK uses tenant-supplied public keys to encrypt the audit envelope; we do not retain private keys. Key format: PEM RSA-2048 or ECDSA P-384. We validated signing/verification in staging.
support: Coverage for window: @Mateo and @Leah. Escalate failed bundle generation or key parse errors to #eng-runtime immediately.
Zoe: Customer-readiness checklist:
- Provide PEM key (RSA-2048 or ECDSA-P384) if BYOK signing is required.
- Ensure management port TCP/15015 is reachable for BYOK handshake and revocation webhook (runtime remains on 15011).
- Decide and document consent policy and how to handle revocations; we store revocation events and issue signed receipts.
- Run preflight and attach results to the support ticket.
API examples:
Record consent:
`curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/777/consent -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"consent":true, "method":"signed-policy"}'`
Revoke consent (new):
`curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/777/consent/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"reason":"policy-change", "request_id":"req-123"}'`
BYOK handshake (upload pubkey):
`curl -X PUT https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/777/byok -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"pubkey":"-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----..."}'`
docs-bot: Docs PR with BYOK formats, consent revocation semantics, and webhook contract merged: https://internal.docs/onprem/byok-consent (will publish customer FAQ after rollout).
Mateo: Any network or cert rotations required?
Zoe: No cert rotations. New management port 15015 for BYOK/revocation webhooks only; please update firewall guidance.
security: Data handling note — when telemetry is enabled we still never export raw prompt text in audit bundles. Revocation events are issued as signed receipts with a timestamp and the hashed consent token. Default retention for revocation records is 365 days; configurable.
Zoe: I will post customer email templates and the support KB after this thread. Monitoring window 6h post-rollout. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
